revision_note: Work packages K01-K09 from PRD v0.2 section 11.3. K01 has three implemented increments: the aarch64 NEON fused packed dot (CPU), the Gate C C0/C1 Metal increment (device/queue owner, typed handles, grouped dispatch, packed Q8_0 GEMV + F16/F32 utilities), and the C2 increment (complete dense-Qwen3 decode on the GPU, validated against the CPU scalar oracle on the pinned Qwen3-0.6B artifact). K02 gains its Metal increment with C3: packed batched GEMM plus chunked causal prefill (batched norms, RoPE, masked GQA attention, KV writes, SwiGLU, residuals), last-position-only vocabulary projection, preflight geometry admission for the micro-batch and chunk-independent numerics (bit-identical logits across batch sizes 1-8). A kernel must never be selected before its correctness gate passes; every selection retains a validated reference fallback decision.

kernels.name: Q8/Q4 packed matrix-vector decode
gates: exact format/scale decoding
bounded tiles, no full dequantized matrix
per-operation error checks registered before tuning
Metal increment: Q8_0 GEMV + F16/F32 utilities match the scalar reference incl. real tensor bytes (C1, tolerance-registered)

kernels.name: Shape-specific prompt matrix multiplication
gates: same projection semantics as reference
microbatch size recorded in plan
no unbounded prompt workspace

Metal increment: packed batched GEMM + chunked causal prefill; per-token arithmetic identical across batch sizes; effective batch is the largest candidate whose exact workspace geometry fits the plan (C3)

kernels.name: RMSNorm, activation and residual fusion
gates: epsilon, operation dependencies and rounding profile preserved
no approximate activation substitution
Metal increment: RMSNorm/Q-K norm/SwiGLU/residual kernels match the scalar oracle within the registered f32 policy (C2)

kernels.name: Ternary PQ2_0 / PTQ1_0 projection and embedding kernels
gates: native code and scale handling

kernels.name: Hadamard/sign transforms and safe fusion

kernels.name: Capability-compatible arithmetic (BF16/F16/F32)
